description: Changes a screenshot set create_project made, before the user saves it: rewrite any screen's screen name or headline, or change the background colour, the frame colour or the device. The uploaded screenshots stay as they are. Returns new previews and warnings; the open_url finish_project gave then opens the new version. For anything more (the phone's place, size or fold, text styles, pieces, another canvas), use edit_asset with this project_handle as handle, no sign-in needed; once it has changed the set, keep using edit_asset. A set the user already saved changes with edit_asset by asset_id.

device.description: A device id from list_devices that suits the set's canvas.

frame_color.description: A colour id of the device from list_devices.

screens.description: Only the screens and captions that change.

headline.description: The big line: the benefit this screen shows, 2 to 6 words, 32 characters or fewer (40 at most; longer is set smaller). Sentence case, no trailing period. Example: "See where every dollar goes".

screen_name.description: The screen or feature name, shown as the small line: 1 to 3 words, at most 24 characters. Example: "Weekly stats".

name: update_project
title: Change a screenshot project
